name: wild-willows
description: Wild Willows — a cozy nature-restoration life sim, backed by Harper

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web

comment: Everything here is build-time only. The deployed Harper component is prebuilt (bundled resources.js + the static web/ build), so it has NO runtime npm dependencies — phaser/react/etc. are baked into web/assets at build time, and resources.js bundles its own imports. Keeping these out of `dependencies` is what stops Harper from trying to install the (large) phaser package on deploy.
